summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broader market, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C and 8000C strikes expiring in 2026 and 2027. While NDX and MSFT show extreme intraday call dominance (P/C < 0.25), the massive multi-day persistence in SPX 7000C ($5.2B) and 8000C ($2.9B) through 2031 indicates a structural, long-term bet on index expansion. Traders should monitor for volatility around SPX levels, as the heavy accumulation of 8000P contracts ($1.2B+ across multiple dates) suggests institutions are simultaneously hedging against extreme tail risk despite the bullish call bias. Watch for any breakdown in SPX support that could trigger the realized volatility of these massive long-dated put positions.
